name: Fold Stop
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Makes the restore command expand only its own note.
Keeps the restore choice when a note is renamed.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Restore normal folding in this note now unfolds only that note. Folds in your other notes stay.
The restore choice stays with a note when you rename it.
tip: Run Restore normal folding in this note to unfold the active note and use normal folding again.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Fold Stop is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for keeping it in your editor.

related.name: Visual Line Numbers
related.blurb: Numbers every wrapped display line in the editor gutter, with relative, hybrid and absolute modes, so counted Vim motions land where the gutter says.

related.name: Paragraph Spell Focus
related.blurb: Limit native spellcheck to the paragraph under the cursor.
